code.nodes/calibrated.py:
"""Apply the fitted curve to every reading the rig recorded: what the calibration delivers.

The curve is fitted on standardized powers of the reading; here it is expanded into plain
polynomial coefficients, so that `reference ≈ c0 + c1·r + c2·r² + …` can be used anywhere
without this app. It is applied to every row of the measurements, the ones dropped as
missing or as spikes included, so the delivered file has the rig's data as it came, with
the calibrated value and its residual appended.
"""
import duckdb
import numpy as np

from blocks import ui

GROUP = "Delivery"
METRICS = {"rows": "rows calibrated"}


def calibrated(measurements, featurize, train, evaluate):
    reading, reference = np.array(duckdb.sql(f"SELECT reading, reference FROM read_parquet('{measurements}')").fetchall(), dtype=float).T
    w = np.asarray(train["coef"]) / featurize["sd"]                    # per power of the raw reading
    coef = np.concatenate([[train["intercept"] - float(w @ featurize["mu"])], w])
    value = np.polyval(coef[::-1], reading)
    return {"table": {"reading": reading, "reference": reference, "calibrated": value, "residual": value - reference},
            "coefficients": coef, "rows": len(reading),
            "quality": {"test_rmse": evaluate["test_rmse"], "test_r2": evaluate["test_r2"], "max_abs_error": evaluate["max_abs_error"]}}


def equation(coef) -> str:
    terms = [f"{coef[0]:.6g}"] + [f"{c:+.6g}·r" + (f"^{k}" if k > 1 else "") for k, c in enumerate(coef) if k]
    return "reference ≈ " + " ".join(terms).replace("+", "+ ").replace("-", "- ").replace("≈ - ", "≈ -")


def view(out):
    return [
        ui.markdown(f"The calibration curve, for a raw reading `r`:\n\n`{equation(out['coefficients'])}`\n\n"
                    f"Applied to all {out['rows']} recorded readings (rows with a missing value give no calibrated value)."),
        ui.data(out["table"], title="Calibrated readings", id="table"),
    ]


def downloads(out):
    q = out["quality"]
    report = "\n".join([
        "# Sensor calibration", "",
        "The curve that maps the low-cost sensor's raw reading `r` to the reference instrument:", "",
        f"    {equation(out['coefficients'])}", "",
        "| coefficient | value |", "|---|---|",
        *[f"| c{k} (r^{k}) | {c:.10g} |" for k, c in enumerate(out["coefficients"])], "",
        "On held-out rows the curve never saw:", "",
        f"- RMSE: {q['test_rmse']:.4g}", f"- R²: {q['test_r2']:.4g}", f"- largest error: {q['max_abs_error']:.4g}", "",
        f"Applied to {out['rows']} readings in calibrated.csv (reading, reference, calibrated, residual).", ""])
    return [ui.file("calibrated.csv", out["table"], title="every reading with its calibrated value and residual"),
            ui.file("calibration.md", report, title="the curve's equation, coefficients and quality")]
code.nodes/evaluate.py:
"""Score the calibration curve on held-out rows it never saw.

RMSE and R² of the reference value predicted from the reading, the worst single error, and
RMSE relative to the straight-line baseline (below 1 means the curve earns its keep).
"""
import numpy as np

from blocks import ui

GROUP = "Modelling"
METRICS = {
    "test_rmse": {"label": "RMSE", "goal": "min", "headline": True},
    "test_r2": {"label": "R²", "goal": "max", "headline": True},
    "max_abs_error": {"label": "max error", "goal": "min", "headline": True},
    "rmse_vs_baseline": {"label": "RMSE vs baseline", "goal": "min"},
}


def evaluate(train, featurize, baseline):
    pred = featurize["Xte"] @ train["coef"] + train["intercept"]
    y, x = featurize["yte"], featurize["xte"]
    err = pred - y
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(err ** 2)))
    order = np.argsort(x)
    return {"test_rmse": rmse, "rmse_vs_baseline": rmse / baseline["baseline_rmse"],
            "test_r2": 1.0 - float(np.sum(err ** 2)) / float(np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2)),
            "max_abs_error": float(np.max(np.abs(err))),
            "reading": x[order], "reference": y[order], "predicted": pred[order], "residual": err[order]}


def view(out):
    worst = int(np.argmax(np.abs(out["residual"])))
    return [
        ui.metrics(),
        ui.markdown(f"{len(out['reading'])} held-out readings. The worst is off by {abs(out['residual'][worst]):.2f} at "
                    f"reading {out['reading'][worst]:.2f}; RMSE is {out['rmse_vs_baseline']:.0%} of the straight line's."),
        ui.chart(out["reading"], {"reference": out["reference"], "predicted": out["predicted"]},
                 kind={"reference": "scatter", "predicted": "line"}, title="Calibration curve on held-out rows",
                 x_label="reading", id="curve"),
        ui.chart(out["reading"], {"residual": out["residual"]}, kind="scatter", title="Residuals on held-out rows",
                 x_label="reading", id="residuals"),
    ]
code.nodes/prepare.py:
"""Clean the rig's raw readings and split them into training and held-out rows.

Rows with a missing value are dropped. Connector spikes are screened against a robust cubic
trend: a row whose residual exceeds `outlier_z` MAD-scaled standard deviations is removed.
What is left is split at random (`seed`) into training rows and a held-out
`test_fraction`, on which the curve is later scored.
"""
from typing import Annotated

import duckdb
import numpy as np

from blocks import Note, Range, ui

GROUP = "Data preparation"
SCHEMA = {
    "measurements": {"fields": [
        {"name": "reading", "type": "number", "constraints": {"minimum": 0, "maximum": 12},
         "description": "Raw reading of the low-cost sensor (0–10 on the calibrated range)."},
        {"name": "reference", "type": "number", "description": "The reference instrument's value for the same sample."},
    ]},
}
METRICS = {
    "n_raw": "rows read",
    "n_train": "train rows",
    "n_outliers": {"label": "outliers dropped", "goal": "min"},
}


def prepare(measurements, *,
            test_fraction: Annotated[float, Range(0.1, 0.5, 0.05)] = 0.25,
            seed: int = 42,
            outlier_z: Annotated[float, Range(1.5, 6, 0.5), Note("robust z cut for spikes")] = 3.0):
    # DuckDB reads the Parquet file in place (it is mounted read-only, never copied).
    data = np.array(duckdb.sql(f"SELECT reading, reference FROM read_parquet('{measurements}')").fetchall(), dtype=float)
    n_raw = len(data)
    data = data[~np.isnan(data).any(axis=1)]
    x, y = data[:, 0], data[:, 1]
    resid = y - np.polyval(np.polyfit(x, y, 3), x)
    mad = np.median(np.abs(resid - np.median(resid))) * 1.4826
    keep = np.abs(resid - np.median(resid)) <= outlier_z * max(mad, 1e-12)
    kept = data[keep]
    idx = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(kept))
    n_test = int(round(len(kept) * test_fraction))
    test, train = kept[idx[:n_test]], kept[idx[n_test:]]
    return {"train": train, "test": test, "screen": {"x": x, "y": y, "keep": keep},
            "n_raw": n_raw, "n_missing": n_raw - len(data), "n_outliers": int((~keep).sum()),
            "n_train": len(train), "n_test": len(test)}


def view(out):
    s = out["screen"]
    return [
        ui.metrics(),
        ui.markdown(f"Of {out['n_raw']} readings, {out['n_missing']} had a missing value and {out['n_outliers']} were "
                    f"screened out as spikes; {out['n_train']} train the curve and {out['n_test']} are held out."),
        ui.chart(s["x"], {"kept": np.where(s["keep"], s["y"], np.nan), "screened out": np.where(s["keep"], np.nan, s["y"])},
                 kind="scatter", title="Readings against the reference", x_label="reading", y_label="reference", id="screen"),
        ui.data({"reading": out["train"][:, 0], "reference": out["train"][:, 1]}, title="Training rows", id="train"),
    ]
code.nodes/train.py:
"""Closed-form ridge regression of the reference value on the standardized features.

The intercept is the training mean and is not penalized; `alpha` shrinks the coefficients,
trading a little training fit for a curve that behaves past the calibrated range.
"""
from typing import Annotated

import numpy as np

from blocks import Note, Range

GROUP = "Modelling"
METRICS = {"train_rmse": {"label": "train RMSE", "goal": "min"}}


def train(featurize, *, alpha: Annotated[float, Range(0.0001, 10, log=True), Note("ridge penalty")] = 0.1):
    X, y = featurize["Xtr"], featurize["ytr"]
    y_mean = y.mean()
    w = np.linalg.solve(X.T @ X + alpha * np.eye(X.shape[1]), X.T @ (y - y_mean))
    pred = X @ w + y_mean
    return {"intercept": float(y_mean), "coef": w, "train_rmse": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((pred - y) ** 2)))}
